name: electron-mcp-server-workspace
description: Workspace: packages/electron-mcp-server (MCP bin) + examples/electron-mcp-demo (example Electron app).

scripts.build: bun run --filter @ohah/electron-mcp-server build && bun run --filter electron-mcp-demo build
scripts.dev: bun run build:mcp && bun run --filter electron-mcp-demo dev
scripts.test:e2e:mcp: bun run build:demo && bun run --filter @ohah/electron-mcp-server test:e2e:mcp
scripts.test:e2e:electron: bun run build:demo && bun run --filter @ohah/electron-mcp-server test:e2e:electron
